meta.description: Get in touch with HeatEx Direct. Whether you're a buyer or manufacturer, reach out for product inquiries, profile updates, partnerships, or any questions. We respond within 48 hours.
meta.keywords: Contact, Heat Exchangers, China Manufacturer, Sourcing, Support, Partnership

og.title: Contact HeatEx Direct
og.description: Have questions about sourcing heat exchangers? Need to update your manufacturer profile? Contact us — we respond within 48 hours.

hero.title: Get In Touch
hero.subtitle: Whether you're a global buyer or a Chinese manufacturer, we'd love to hear from you.
hero.description: Have a question, need an update, or want to explore a partnership? Drop us an email and our team will get back to you within 48 hours.

reasons.title: Common Reasons to Reach Out
reasons.description: No matter your role in the supply chain, we're here to support you.

inquiry.title: Product & Sourcing Inquiries
inquiry.description: Looking for a specific type of heat exchanger? Need help identifying the right manufacturer for your project? Let us know your requirements.

profile.title: Manufacturer Profile Updates
profile.description: Already listed on our platform? Request updates to your company profile, certifications, production data, or contact information.

partnership.title: Partnership & Collaboration
partnership.description: Interested in listing your factory on HeatEx Direct or exploring content marketing opportunities? We'd love to discuss how we can work together.

feedback.title: Feedback & Suggestions
feedback.description: Your feedback helps us improve. Share your thoughts on how we can make the platform better for buyers and manufacturers alike.

media.title: Media & Press
media.description: For media inquiries, interviews, or press-related questions, please reach out and we'll connect you with the right team member.

other.title: General Questions
other.description: Anything else on your mind? Don't hesitate to reach out. No question is too small — we're happy to help.

cta.title: Ready to Connect?
cta.subtitle: Send us an email and we'll get back to you within 48 hours.
cta.note: We read every email personally. Whether it's a quick question or a detailed inquiry, you'll hear back from a real person on our team.
